    • Connector

      public Connector(int outputTechnology, int connectorInstance, @Nullable DisplayMode mode)
      Describes a connector from a DISPLAYCONFIG_TARGET_DEVICE_NAME's fields and the path's mode.
      Parameters:
      outputTechnology - the DISPLAYCONFIG_VIDEO_OUTPUT_TECHNOLOGY value
      connectorInstance - the connector instance number
      mode - the path's current mode, as read by DisplayConnector.readMode(LongToIntFunction, LongToIntFunction, int), or null if unknown
